scope:
Three strictly serial rotations with analytic removal of two known vacuum ports.
The physical output has four ports. All samplers that accept two active ports
use that reduction and pad zeros back; Frugal retains its four-port-only ABI.
This avoids the expensive upstream v2 traversal of empty high-photon prefixes.
One-thread resource comparisons and separate16-thread throughput. All include
model/core preparation, sampling, count-to-click conversion and destruction.
Imports and DLL loading are excluded for every method. Repetitions deliberately
replay fixed control records, never contribute additional quality N.
